Open-drain = atom bit 0x16 (asm_test_atom_bit) selects mux 3 / 4 / 6 instead of 1 / 2 / 5. CFF: MIO_PIN_MODE bit 0 -> 1 (od vs out, 3 / 3 sites); QSF AUTO_OPEN_DRAIN_PINS only switches detection (constant-0 tri-state data), od vs od_off bit-identical
direction branch: atom bit 4 input, 5 output, 6 bidir (test_bit). in / out / tri / bidir share the same CFF PIN_MODE bit; they differ in CFF SLEW / PULLUP / PULLDOWN strength + PCI_DIODE_CLAMP groups
IO block groups: MIO_SELECT_IOST_DIRT 3 or 4 elements (4th = bit shared with a neighbouring pad or the bank VREF pad), element i = value bit i
vector<uint> first element = delta vs the previous vector of the same field; BLOCK_INFO m_block_lists restart at 0 per BLOCK_INFO (LAB instance cells equal the oracle-checked body run)

calculate_bits_traditional: addr' = (addr / W + hi) * W + addr % W + lo, W = m_num_ram_cols (6154), (hi << 16 | lo) = m_block_lists[1][instance]; W == 0: addr + cell. CFF-tagged (101) addresses add m_block_lists[3][instance]; literals (11) unchanged. No sign flip, no constant.
PLL config = CFF (absolute addresses), one path per PLL index

PLL groups (block types 43 FAST_PLL, 45 GENERAL_PLL) carry CFF-tagged absolute addresses; path k = PLL index k. M9K content = RAM_CONTENT_YGR_MEAB 9,216-bit mux, position p holds mem_init bit (p mod 256)*36 + p div 256

Carry chain placement rule: LE n > 0 <- LE n-1 of the same LAB; LE 0 <- LE 15 of the LAB at Y+1 (same X); m_chain_skip_half_labs per base_family (6 -> 1, 0xe / 0x10 -> 0, 0x38 -> 1) also allows LE 8 <- LE 15 above
LAB_ENABLE_SYNC_SIGNALS value per (sload idx, sclr idx): 3 both, 1 sload only, 2 sclr only, 4 sload = VCC, 5 sload = VCC + sclr; value -> bits through the mux map
LE_CLEAR_SELECT: an LE without ACLR selects the signal whose real source is NULL (value 1 if aclr 1 unused, else 0); both unused = ground
LAB_CLR_INVERT_PAIR value bit k = polarity of aclr k; second bit = 1 when only the first signal is used and its source is not fabric (types 0xdc / 0xe1)
LE_USE_REGISTER_FEEDBACK = 1: the LE's DATAC input is its own register (ff-lcell pair, direct connection)

VIRTUAL_LAB_LINE table (11 x 5 dwords at 0x3cda00): field 1 = signal mask (4 CLK, 2 ENA, 0x40 SLOAD, 8 ACLR, 0x20 SCLR); lines 0..4 = clk0, ena0, clk1, ena1, sload = LAB_INVERT gi 0..4; port type -> mask map built in this ctor
LAB model ctor jump table 0x3cd61c by base_family-6: 6 / 0x10 / 0x3d own handlers, {0xe, 0x30}, {0x2e, 0x37, 0x38}, {9, 0x34} shared; STINGRAY (0x30) shares CUDA (0xe)
